trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy of checkout-api, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever deployed to staging, so it didn't qualify). The rollback completed in all three regions.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 and is healthy again, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure and rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. Recommended follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure before attempting any re-deploy.
